description: A tall man with dark curled hair and a moustache stands on a raised step in a green coat with red cuffs and gold buttons, in a vaulted stone hall with columns and banners. Around him, men in long coats and powdered wigs bow or read from scrolls. On a velvet cushion on a draped table at right sit a crown and an orb. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or wall.
